Shelf is sturdy, love the cable management channels, but the drywall anchors are less than useless. The mounting holes are also not spaced in multiples of 16”, so you aren’t likely to be able to get it in more than one stud. We picked up some drywall toggle anchors and also mounted a bracket underneath in the stud to give a little more stability. That being said, it’s holding a lot of stuff and not budging.
